'''''Carthamus creticus''''' is a plant species in the family [[Asteraceae]], related to [[safflower]].

It is native to the [[Mediterranean]] region including [[Europe]] ([[Spain]], [[Portugal]], [[France]], [[Great Britain|Britain]], [[Italy]], [[Greece]], [[Malta]], [[Serbia]], [[Bosnia]], etc.), [[North Africa]] ([[Morocco]], [[Algeria]], [[Libya]]) and southwestern [[Asia]] ([[Turkey]], [[Palestine (region)|Palestine]], [[Cyprus]]). It is also naturalized in New Zealand and California.<ref name=v>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20141112172122/http://dixon.iplantcollaborative.org/CompositaeWeb/Default.aspx?Page=NameDetails&TabNum=3&nameId=97a7bc89-86b6-46db-b340-0c18070e3087|title=Flann, C (ed) 2009+ Global Compositae Checklist}}</ref><ref>[http://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/index1.php?scientific-name=carthamus+creticus Altervista Flora Italiana, Cardoncello cretico, Downy Safflower, Woolly Distaff Thistle,  ''Carthamus creticus'' L. ]</ref>
